summary: A vision becomes a commitment the moment it needs money, time, and someone willing to be responsible for what happens next.
body: A vision becomes a commitment the moment it needs money, time, and someone willing to be responsible for what happens next. When Saturn conjoins Neptune, imagination and structure fuse, giving something intangible enough form to become possible while exposing every place hope had been filling in for missing support. The dream is not less meaningful because it needs a budget, a deadline, or a workable plan. If it matters enough to build, it matters enough to support properly.
